ideas.pitch: A real-time algorithm visualizer and memory tracer specifically built for competitive programming debugging during high-intensity contests.
ideas.problem_statement: Code N Compete: a high-intensity competitive programming challenge designed to push your logic, speed, and problem-solving skills to the limit.
ideas.title: CP-Visualizer & Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on speed and performance during a fast-paced CP challenge, helping participants dry-run complex code efficiently.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative workspace for teams of up to 3 coders to simultaneously write, share, and merge algorithm solutions with integrated test-case generators.
ideas.problem_statement: Code N Compete: a team contest, with each team consisting of up to 3 members.
ideas.title: AlgoDuel Team Workspace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles team collaboration bottlenecks during a 2-hour onsite finale where efficient time management is critical.

ideas.pitch: An offline benchmark and stress-testing tool that generates corner cases and randomized tests to quickly catch edge-case bugs in competitive programming solutions.
ideas.problem_statement: Code N Compete: 5 competitive programming questions, with difficulty increasing according to the index of the question.
ideas.title: SpeedTest CP Stresser
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact pain point of failing hidden test cases on difficult index questions by automating stress-testing against a brute-force script.

ideas.pitch: A live contest strategy dashboard that tracks score allocation, optimal time limits per question index, and team member task distribution.
ideas.problem_statement: Code N Compete: participants will have a total duration of 2 hours to solve all the questions... manage their time effectively.
ideas.title: ContestTactics Time Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the explicit rule about managing time effectively across multiple escalating questions without individual time limits.

ideas.pitch: A lightning-fast extension and web hub for organizing, searching, and injecting optimized competitive programming data structures and algorithm templates.
ideas.problem_statement: Code N Compete: push your logic, speed, and problem-solving skills to the limit.
ideas.title: CP-Snippet Manager & Template Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Saves critical minutes during a tight 2-hour onsite finale by eliminating the need to rewrite standard boilerplate graph or tree algorithms.
